items.title: Home Improvement’s Hangover Could Last
items.summary: Most retailers make their year around Christmas, but the festive season for home improvement is just winding down.  Second-quarter results this week for  Home Depot  and Lowe’s, and numbers already released two weeks ago by  Floor & Decor  will make for a muted celebration.  The three companies’ shares have lagged the S&P 500 by between 35 and 50 percentage points in the past year.

items.title: Ross Stores (ROST) Stock Looks Stretched On Earnings Yet Strong On Returns
items.summary: Ross Stores stock has delivered a strong run over the last few years, yet current valuation checks suggest the shares are not obviously cheap. The recent gains now sit against a low overall value score and market multiples that lean toward an expensive reading. Ross Stores has returned 112.2% over the past 3 years, which puts extra focus on whether the current share price already reflects much of that progress.
